paragraph: This experiment has 3 parts: PRE-TEST, GAME, and POST-TEST.
You will see two shapes on each trial. Decide if they are the 𝐒𝐀𝐌𝐄 or 𝐃𝐈𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐓.
Your job is to indicate whether they are the 𝐒𝐀𝐌𝐄 or 𝐃𝐈𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐓.
If they are the 𝐒𝐀𝐌𝐄, press "𝐒" on the keyboard.
If they are 𝐃𝐈𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐓, press "𝐃" on the keyboard.
It may be difficult to tell if they are the same or different. Take your best guess.
Once completed, you will move onto the GAME.
Pre-Test Will Begin
———  GAME INSTRUCTIONS ———
You are in charge of a space station. Your job is to protect it from 𝐁𝐀𝐃 gas clouds, save 𝐆𝐎𝐎𝐃 gas clouds, and identify 𝐒𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋 gas clouds.
These gas clouds look very similar. Your job is to learn to tell the difference.
press "𝟏" if you think it's a 𝐆𝐎𝐎𝐃 cloud. A green ray will shoot the cloud and save it.
Press "𝟐" if you think it's a 𝐁𝐀𝐃 cloud.  A red ray will shoot the cloud and destroy it.
Press "𝟑"  if you think it's a 𝐒𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋 cloud.  A Blue ray will shoot the cloud and capture it.

After you shoot a cloud, a box will appear showing its true type: Green box = 𝐆𝐎𝐎𝐃 cloud, Red box = 𝐁𝐀𝐃 cloud, Blue box = 𝐒𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋 cloud. Matching colors (ray and box) = correct. Different colors = wrong
You earn or lose points based on your choices.
Your current score is always displayed in the upper right corner.
Wrong choices cause delays before the next cloud appears: Wrong on 𝐆𝐎𝐎𝐃 or 𝐁𝐀𝐃 clouds = 𝟐 𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐲. Wrong on 𝐒𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋 clouds = 𝟖 𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐲
Good luck.
The POST-TEST uses the same rules as the PRE-TEST.
You will see two shapes on each trial. Decide if they are the 𝐒𝐀𝐌𝐄 or 𝐃𝐈𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐓.
Your job is to indicate whether they are the 𝐒𝐀𝐌𝐄 or 𝐃𝐈𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐓.
If they are the 𝐒𝐀𝐌𝐄, press "𝐒" on the keyboard.
If they are 𝐃𝐈𝐅𝐅𝐄𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐓, press "𝐃" on the keyboard.
It may be difficult to tell if they are the same or different. Take your best guess.
Eventually the POST-TEST will end, and then the experiment will be over.
